useYTMLyricsWithoutProxy.description: Fetch YTM's own lyrics directly. Off keeps the direct request and retries through the public browse proxy if it fails.

translationEnabled.label: Translate lyrics
translationEnabled.description: Translate the lyrics shown in the Lyrics tab, and let the app's API translate on request.

translationTargetLanguage.label: Translate into
translationTargetLanguage.description: The app language by default. Translating lyrics already in that language returns them unchanged.

openaiBaseUrl.label: OpenAI-compatible base URL
openaiBaseUrl.description: Any OpenAI-compatible server; /responses and /chat/completions are supported.

localCliCommand.label: Command
localCliCommand.description: The executable to run (default: the engine's command).

localCliModel.label: Model
localCliModel.description: Optional model passed to the CLI.

googleTranslateHost.label: Google Translate host
googleTranslateHost.description: A regional host such as translate.google.co.jp, or your own Google Translate mirror.

musixmatchTokenMode.label: Musixmatch token source
musixmatchTokenMode.description: Automatic asks Musixmatch for the mobile app's token and renews it every minute. Your own token sends the token below instead.

musixmatch.no-token: Musixmatch only gives lyrics to signed-in apps: set a Musixmatch user token in the settings
musixmatch.token-rejected: Musixmatch rejected the user token (expired, or asking for a captcha)

custom-search.open: Search with your own title and artist
custom-search.title: Title

taskbar-mediacontrol.description: Control playback from your Windows taskbar
taskbar-mediacontrol.name: Taskbar Media Control

touchbar.description: Adds a TouchBar widget for macOS users
touchbar.name: TouchBar

type.label: Material
type.description: Blurs what's behind the window. Linux compositors only support plain transparency.

settings.type-description: Background material used for window transparency

port.label: Tuna port
port.description: The port of Tuna's web server source in OBS.

unobtrusive-player.description: Prevents the player from popping up when playing a song
unobtrusive-player.name: Unobtrusive Player

video-toggle.description: Adds a button to switch between Video/Song mode. can also optionally remove the whole video tab
video-toggle.name: Video Toggle

hideVideo.label: Show cover art instead of video
hideVideo.description: Remembered when you use the switch.

forceHide.label: Hide the player completely
forceHide.description: The queue and lyrics take the whole player page.

visualizer.description: Adds a visualizer to the player
visualizer.name: Visualizer

songTitle.label: Milkdrop: show the track title on change

waveAnimations.label: Animations
waveAnimations.description: JSON list of Wave animations ({ type, config }), as in pear-desktop: Cubes, Circles, Lines, Glob, Arcs, Flower, Square, Turntable, Wave, Shine.

settings.prettify-description: Taper the bars towards the edges
settings.dottify-description: Draw dots instead of a continuous line

media-controls.name: Media controls
media-controls.description: Control playback from your desktop's media widgets and keys (MPRIS).

tray.name: Tray icon
tray.description: Playback controls and the current track in the system tray.

closeToTray.label: Close to tray
closeToTray.description: Closing the window keeps music playing in the background.

moveToCurrentDesktop.label: Show the window on the current desktop

audio-only.description: Forces audio-only mode — blocks all video streams at network and player level to save RAM and bandwidth
audio-only.name: Audio Only

always-show-volume-slider.name: Always Show Volume Slider
always-show-volume-slider.description: Keeps the volume slider visible and draggable instead of only showing it on hover.

fullscreen-auto-hide.description: Automatically hide the player controls and mouse cursor after a few seconds of inactivity while in fullscreen
fullscreen-auto-hide.name: Fullscreen Auto-hide

memory-saver.description: Clears the renderer's resource caches while the window is hidden once they grow past a threshold
memory-saver.name: Memory Saver

settings.threshold-description: Clear the caches once their live memory exceeds this while the window is hidden

thresholdMB.label: Threshold
thresholdMB.description: Clear the renderer cache while the window is hidden once the live resource usage exceeds this.

playback-recovery.description: Automatically recovers from stuck, stalled, or dead playback states
playback-recovery.name: Playback Recovery

settings.stall-timeout-description: How long playback may make no progress before a recovery attempt
settings.max-retries-description: Number of recovery attempts before skipping to the next track

stallTimeoutMs.label: Stall timeout
stallTimeoutMs.description: How long playback may make no progress before it is restarted.

maxRetries.label: Retries before skipping
maxRetries.description: After this many recovery attempts the track is skipped; a clean second of playback resets the count.

playlist-search.description: Adds a search input to filter playlists in the sidebar and the Add to playlist dialog
playlist-search.name: Playlist Search

prefer-song.description: Play the song instead of the music video when an album track is a video
prefer-song.name: Prefer Song

commands.play: Play a video from a YouTube link or id

search-commands.description: Type / in the search box to run commands, with autocomplete for their arguments
search-commands.name: Search Commands

settings.open-keybind-description: Electron-style accelerator, e.g. CmdOrCtrl+/ or Alt+Space
settings.open-shortcut: Open the search box from anywhere
settings.open-shortcut-description: Summons the search box already in command mode, like Spotlight. Pressing it again closes it.

openShortcut.label: Spotlight shortcut
openShortcut.description: Summons the command box from anywhere in the window.

openKeybind.label: Shortcut
openKeybind.description: An Electron accelerator, e.g. CmdOrCtrl+/. Leave empty to use no shortcut.

seek-shortcuts.description: Seek 5 seconds backward/forward with the left/right arrow keys
seek-shortcuts.name: Seek Shortcuts

sfw-music.description: Automatically skips songs marked Explicit by YouTube Music. Pauses if an explicit queue repeats or no next song is available.
sfw-music.name: SFW Music

toast-autoclose.description: Automatically close YouTube Music toasts after three seconds
toast-autoclose.name: Toast Auto-Close

includePronunciation.label: Include pronunciation
includePronunciation.description: Use the romanized line when the lyrics have one.

maxLength.label: Maximum length
maxLength.description: Characters shown in the menu bar; 0 hides the title.

statusbar-lyrics.name: Status bar lyrics
statusbar-lyrics.description: Shows the current synced lyric line in the macOS menu bar. Requires Synced lyrics.

dismiss-multidevice-popup.name: Dismiss Multidevice Popup
dismiss-multidevice-popup.description: Automatically closes the "Listen on this device" popup that appears when playback starts on another device.

skip-ai-slop.name: Skip AI slop
skip-ai-slop.description: Skips and hides AI-generated tracks, using keywords, your own lists and a community list.

hideInPages.label: Hide in pages
hideInPages.description: Hides flagged tracks in search, home, explore, library and playlists.

reportFeedback.label: Send "Not interested" for recommendations
reportFeedback.description: Sends permanent feedback for flagged home and explore cards. Slow, limited, and off by default.

communityList.label: Use the community list
communityList.description: Matches the downloaded list of flagged channels and tracks.

keywords.label: Blocked keywords
keywords.description: Skips tracks whose title or channel name contains one of these as a whole word (for example, “AI cover”).

userBlock.label: Blocked channels
userBlock.description: Channel ids (UC…) or exact channel names that are always filtered.

userAllow.label: Allowed channels
userAllow.description: Channel ids (UC…) or exact channel names that are never filtered. This always wins over the lists and keywords.

listSearch.label: Community list search
listSearch.description: A channel or track name or id; the “Search list” button reports matches on the status line.

clearCache.label: Clear saved data
clearCache.description: Removes the saved list, its names, recent matches and feedback history.

showRecent.label: Show recently filtered
showRecent.description: Puts the latest matches on this plugin's status line.

searchList.label: Search the community list
searchList.description: Searches the saved names for the text in “Community list search”.

resumeOnStart.label: Reopen the last page
resumeOnStart.description: Start where you left off (never straight into playback).

startingPage.label: Starting page
startingPage.description: Used when the last page isn't reopened.

autoUpdates.label: Check for updates
autoUpdates.description: Tells you when a new version is out.

appVisible.label: Show the window at startup
appVisible.description: Off: start hidden in the tray (needs the Tray icon plugin; otherwise the window shows as usual).

swapLikeButtonsOrder.label: Swap the like and dislike buttons

usePodcastParticipantAsArtist.label: Show the listed participant as a podcast's artist
usePodcastParticipantAsArtist.description: Off: the channel that publishes it, usually the host. Used in notifications and integrations.

themes.label: Themes
themes.description: CSS files applied on top of YouTube Music.

disableHardwareAcceleration.label: Disable hardware acceleration
disableHardwareAcceleration.description: Try this if video or animations flicker or the window stays black.

proxy.label: Proxy
proxy.description: For proxies that need a username and password, use the Proxy plugin.

enabled.label: Enable the API server
enabled.description: Lets other apps control playback and read the current song over HTTP and WebSocket.

hostname.label: Hostname
hostname.description: 127.0.0.1 accepts connections only from this computer; 0.0.0.0 from your network too.

options.AUTH_AT_FIRST: Ask when a new client connects
options.NONE: None (anyone who can reach the port)

authorizedClients.label: Authorized clients
authorizedClients.description: Client IDs that may use the API. Remove one to revoke it.

secret.label: Token secret
secret.description: Signs access tokens; changing it signs every client out. Generated when empty.

playerBar.label: Player bar
playerBar.description: YouTube Music is trying a new player bar on some users. The one it didn't choose for you works, but without like buttons: it only sends them for its choice.

siteFlags.label: Feature flag overrides
siteFlags.description: One flag per entry, as name=value (true, false, a number or text). Unknown names do nothing.

updateChannel.label: Update channel
updateChannel.description: Beta gets the rolling build from master; stable gets versioned releases.

stripMusicFromSharedLinks.label: Strip 'music.' from shared links
stripMusicFromSharedLinks.description: Turns music.youtube.com links back into regular ones.

stripSIFromSharedLinks.label: Strip 'si' from shared links
stripSIFromSharedLinks.description: Drops YTM's tracking parameter from links copied by the share dialog.

performanceMode.label: Performance mode
performanceMode.description: Cheaper site flags, no animations or backdrop blur, and lighter visual plugins.

inProcessGpu.label: Run the GPU process in the app process
inProcessGpu.description: Experimental: saves a process, but may fall back to software rendering.

forceSmtc.label: Use Windows media controls
forceSmtc.description: Replaces Chromium's media session with the native System Media Transport Controls.

mcpEnabled.label: Enable MCP
mcpEnabled.description: Exposes the API server's operations as Model Context Protocol tools at /mcp.

useYtmIcons.label: Use YouTube Music's icons
useYtmIcons.description: The window, tray and About artwork use YTM's logo instead of Pear Desktop's.

hideDislikeButton.label: Hide the dislike button
hideDislikeButton.description: Only the old player bar has one to hide.

hideVideoCaptions.label: Hide video captions
hideVideoCaptions.description: Hides the player's captions button; captions already on keep showing.

overrideUserAgent.label: Override the user agent
overrideUserAgent.description: Send a plain Chrome user agent instead of Electron's; some sites behave differently.

settings-ui.title: Settings
settings-ui.restart-banner: Some changes need a restart to take effect.
settings-ui.restart-plugin-hint: Enabling or disabling applies after a restart
settings-ui.shortcut-hint: Click, then press a key combination. Backspace clears, Escape cancels.

developer.label: Developer Tweaks
developer.sub: Site feature flags and developer tools

about.tagline: A feature-rich desktop app for YouTube Music

site-flags.hint: The flags YouTube Music sent this session. Switching one adds it to the overrides above, after a restart. Most only change what the server sends, so overriding them does nothing.
site-flags.more: {{count}} more; narrow the filter to see them.

settings-ui.name: Settings UI
settings-ui.description: Adds an in-app settings panel, opened from the sidebar

settings.show-button: Show the settings entry in the sidebar
settings.show-button-description: Turn this off to keep the sidebar clean; Settings is still under Navigation → Open Settings.
settings.separate-window: Always open Settings in a separate window
settings.separate-window-description: Opens the standalone settings window, the way the tray entry does, instead of the in-app panel.

flags.warning: Feature flags are YouTube Music's own internal switches. Changing them can break playback, layout or account features, and they are not covered by support. Overrides are kept only for the flags you change, and can be removed with Undo.
flags.empty: This page exposes no feature flags.
flags.add-value-hint: JSON when it parses (true, 42, "text"), the text itself otherwise

fields.performance-mode-desc: Trade some visual fidelity for cheaper rendering.
fields.in-process-gpu: Merge the GPU process into the app process
fields.in-process-gpu-desc: Experimental: saves one process, but moves GPU memory into the main process and can fall back to software rendering.
fields.podcast-artist-desc: Off: a podcast episode’s artist is the channel that published it.

themes.description: Themes are folders in the themes directory, each with a theme.json manifest. Pick one here or under Options › Theme.
themes.empty: No theme folders yet. Create one in the themes folder, or import a CSS file.
themes.js-blocked: This theme's script is blocked until you allow it. Theme scripts run with full access to the app.
themes.declined: The theme's script was not allowed.
themes.author: by {{author}}
themes.no-variables: This theme's palette has no variables to edit.
